title: Confirm the full resolution above?
body: This is the complete resolution, built from your answers in rounds 1 to 3. If you confirm, I post it on Choose skill bundles and update policy, close the ticket, and add a line to the map's Decisions so far. I also narrow the two fog items under Map follow-through and add a pointer to the map's Notes. No new ticket is created. If anything is wrong or missing, choose the second option and say what in the notes.
rec: Confirm and record, if it matches what you decided.
